_about: Where the art is in each live Prism Token image (Tebex category 3501348, the 2026-11-12 files at these CDN URLs, all 2000x2000 RGBA). art = bounding box of the pixels with alpha >= 250, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in source px, x1/y1 exclusive. Measured with Pillow from the downloaded files in round 1 and re-measured from the same files in round 2 (identical). This is the tests' independent truth: it is NOT read from src/data/imageCrops.json and tools/image_crops.py never reads it. shadow = bounding box of alpha >= 64 (art plus the soft drop shadow, which runs out to the left and below); a crop box that reaches into it is not tight. Tests: test/image_crop.test.mjs (each committed box must contain art and exceed it by at most 12 px per edge) and test/image_crop_check.mjs (the CDN stub serves a 2000x2000 PNG that is opaque exactly on art, and AC1 measures coverage and cut-off against art).
